name: claude-code-speed
description: Status-bar indicator showing the token throughput and timing of your latest Claude Code interaction.

commands.title: Claude Code Speed: Show / Hide Stats Tab
Claude Code Speed: Configure Claude Code Telemetry

claudeCodeSpeed.port.description: Localhost port the embedded OTLP/HTTP receiver listens on. Must match the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT configured for Claude Code.

enumDescriptions: output tokens / total request time (matches Claude Code's 'Output Tokens / sec')
output tokens / generation time (total minus time-to-first-token)
claudeCodeSpeed.speedBasis.description: How the tok/sec figure on the status bar is computed.

claudeCodeSpeed.exportIntervalMs.description: OTEL_LOGS_EXPORT_INTERVAL written when auto-configuring Claude Code. Lower = more responsive status bar, more frequent exports.

claudeCodeSpeed.statusBarPriority.description: Status bar priority. Higher = further left within the right-hand cluster.

claudeCodeSpeed.retentionDays.description: Discard interactions older than this many days from the shared history file (~/.claude-code-speed/state.json).
